passages.title: The interview
passages.text: Interviewer: Thanks for coming in, Sofia. So, tell me about yourself. Sofia: Sure. I have a degree in marketing, and I have six years of experience in online sales. At the moment, I'm in charge of a small team at a travel company. Interviewer: What would you say are your strengths and weaknesses? Sofia: I'm good at solving problems under pressure. My weakness is that I sometimes find it hard to say no, but I'm working on it. Interviewer: Great. Do you have any questions for us? Sofia: Yes. What are the next steps in the process?
